A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same infomorphic-neuron study. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A.1–A.11 are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original MNIST and CIFAR-10 experiments, parameter ablations, convergence analyses, and preliminary deeper-network results.

after.justification: v4 retains these original classification experiments and supplementary empirical analyses.

M1.justification: The PID objectives, neuron architectures, activation functions, connectivity setups, and training/inference procedures are retained. Function 3 removes an erroneous lateral variable from its bivariate conditional probability, matching the procedure already described elsewhere in v3.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate MNIST and CIFAR-10 classification with the same represented tasks and scenarios. The deeper-network examples in Appendix A.10 are already present in v3.

E2.justification: Figures 3 and 8 retain the same backpropagation, random-projection, direct-classification, and bivariate context/lateral comparisons. Revised figure labels identify existing setups rather than new comparators.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, validation holdouts, Table 1 training settings, model configurations, and Appendix A.11 sensitivity protocols are unchanged. The newly explicit optimization parameter bounds do not establish that the experimental protocol changed.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same individual and cumulative parameter ablations, parameter perturbations, convergence analyses, alternative-activation comparison, deeper-network examples, and batch-size/bin-count studies. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both retain mean and minimum–maximum reporting over 10 runs in Figures 3–4, three optimizations per sampler, and 10 initializations for the batch-size experiments. No new uncertainty estimation or statistical testing is reported.

E6.justification: Reported values and plotted findings match. Examples include 92.8% versus 94.9% MNIST accuracy for heuristic versus optimized goals with 100 neurons, and 42.5% versus 42.2% CIFAR-10 accuracy for the optimized infomorphic network versus backpropagation. Appendix results and Table 3 parameter values are retained.

T1.justification: Appendix A.7 changes Equation (5)'s summation condition from a∈α to α⊆a, without explaining the revised antichain notation. Table 2 corrects the {FC}{FL} atom's second synergy from feedforward–context to feedforward–lateral. The remaining mathematical framework is retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: interpretable local PID objectives, three input classes enabling self-organization, heuristic or optimized goals, and classification performance comparable to backpropagation.

C2.justification: Interpretations of task relevance, redundancy versus uniqueness, and convergence are retained, as are limitations concerning depth, discrete outputs, and biological implementation. Appendix A.10 clarifies wording about bivariate goals without changing the existing interpretation.

D1.justification: Appendix A.6 and Table 3 explicitly disclose optimization bounds γ_i∈[-1,1], and Function 3 corrects its conditional probability to p(y|f,c). Figure 10 drops its explicit reference to Table 1 settings. Hardware, compute estimates, listed hyperparameters, and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are retained. Changes such as Makkeh et al.'s 2023 preprint becoming a 2025 journal citation are publication-metadata updates to the same work, not added related research.

P1.justification: v4 makes limited grammatical edits and paragraph refinements, clarifies appendix wording, updates affiliations and acknowledgments, and adopts author–year citations. The section order and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: v4 changes the document template and refreshes figure colors, labels, sizing, and legends, including Figures 1–4 and 9–11. Figure 7's explanatory caption largely moves into Appendix A.8. The same 11 figures and three tables remain, with their principal panel structures preserved.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly improves clarity and reproducibility by stating optimization bounds, correcting the bivariate pseudocode conditional, and fixing Table 2's duplicated synergy description. Presentation also improves in places. The empirical evidence and limitations remain unchanged, and Equation (5)'s revised notation is insufficiently explained to establish a theoretical improvement.
